strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Wonke uxhumano lubethelwe (HTTPS) futhi isayithi linyanzelisa ukubethela kukho konke ukuvakasha (HSTS). Ithuluzi lokuvikela libethela ama-PDF akho nge-AES-256; iphasiwedi oyikhethayo ayilondolozwa neze.

strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Isayithi, amathuluzi e-PDF nawesithombe: i-Vercel, isikhungo sedatha saseParis (France, European Union). Ukuguqulwa kwe-Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint: i-Render, eFrankfurt (Germany, European Union). Amafayela angaphezu kuka-4 MB: isitoreji sesikhashana se-Vercel Blob, ngaphansi kwegama elingahleliwe, elisuswe ngemva kokusetshenziswa.

strings.legal.accessibility.description: Isitatimende sokufinyeleleka se-pdffusion: inhloso ye-WCAG 2.2 level AA, izinyathelo ezikhona, imikhawulo eyaziwayo nokuthi ungayibika kanjani inkinga.

strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: i-pdffusion ihlose ukuhambisana Neziqondiso Zokufinyeleleka Kombhalo Wewebhu (WCAG) 2.2, level AA, isilinganiso samazwe ngamazwe se-W3C. strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: i-pdffusion ihambisana ngokwengxenye ne-WCAG 2.2 level AA: imikhawulo eyaziwayo ibhalwe ngezansi. strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Okukhona endaweni
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Lonke isayithi lisebenza ngekhibhodi, elinesixhumanisi esithi “Yiyaokuqu” nomugqa obonakalayo entweni esebenzayo. Ulimi lwekhasi ngalinye liyamenyezelwa, futhi isi-Arabhu siboniswa kusuka ngakwesokudla kuya ngakwesokunxele.
